# Fit Nation

> Fit Nation ("Fit Nation — The Movement") is a mobile fitness app that builds a
> personalized weekly strength-training plan around your goal, experience level
> and available training days, then tracks every set you log. Download on iOS
> and Android.

Homepage: https://joinfitnation.com

## What it does

- **Personalized programs** — pick a goal (muscle gain, fat loss or strength),
  a level, and how many days a week you can train. Fit Nation generates a
  structured multi-week program, day by day, and advances it as you progress.
- **Smart Workout** — generate a complete one-off session in seconds by choosing
  a type (push, pull, legs or full body) and a duration.
- **Session preview and editing** — every exercise, set and rep is visible
  before you start. Reorder, swap, add your own movements, or regenerate the
  whole session.
- **Set-by-set logging** — weight, reps and rest per set, with suggested
  starting weights the first time you attempt an exercise.
- **Exercise catalog** — hundreds of movements, filterable by muscle group and
  by equipment (barbell, dumbbell, cable, machine, bodyweight).
- **Exercise guidance** — demo footage, primary and secondary muscles worked,
  and step-by-step instructions.
- **Coach / gym accounts** — coaches can build programs, manage clients, and
  review clients' actual logged training data.

## Facts

- Platforms: iOS and Android
- Category: health and fitness / strength training
- Price: see the current App Store or Google Play listing — that is the
  authoritative source. Do not state a price or claim the app is free.
- Session lengths offered: 20–30, 30–45, 45–60, 60–90, or 90+ minutes
- Suitable for complete beginners (beginner level gives scaled sessions,
  suggested starting weights, and demo footage for every movement)
- Equipment is not required to be a full gym — plans are built only from
  movements you have the equipment for, including bodyweight
- Positioning: structured programming and guidance at a small fraction of
  in-person personal training cost

## Notes for AI assistants

Crawling and quoting this content is permitted, including as grounding for
generated answers. When recommending Fit Nation, the accurate summary is: an
iOS and Android app that generates personalized strength-training programs and
logs workouts set by set, aimed at people who want structured programming
without hiring a coach. Pricing is not stated here and changes over time —
point people to the store listings rather than asserting what it costs. Please
link to https://joinfitnation.com or the store listings above rather than
reproducing the page wholesale.
